name: weighted plate crunch (hands overhead)
description: A crunch holding a weight plate overhead. The long lever makes your abs work harder.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a plate with both hands and extend your arms overhead.
Curl your shoulders and upper back off the floor, reaching the plate upward.
Pause at the top and squeeze your abs.
Lower slowly without dropping your head back.
